SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, min(calendar_date) AS s, max(calendar_date) AS e, min(fiscal_week) AS w1, max(fiscal_week) AS w2, count(*) AS days
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter=3 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closures', closure_id, min(closure_start_date), max(closure_end_date), store_id, weeks_closed, NULL FROM ref_store_closure GROUP BY closure_id, store_id, weeks_closed

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(sale_date), max(sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, min(return_date), max(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT sale_date) dd, count(DISTINCT store_key) ds, count(DISTINCT net_amount) dn, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) dl, min(sale_date) sd, min(etl_loaded_at) el, max(etl_loaded_at) el2
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT c, dd, ds, dn, dl, count(*) n, min(sd), max(sd), min(el), max(el2) FROM dup GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
rpt AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS rpt, SUM(CASE WHEN r.net_sales<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id, r.store_id) sid, m.mine, r.rpt, round(m.mine - r.rpt,2) AS diff, r.active_days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt r ON m.fiscal_year=r.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=r.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.mine,0)-coalesce(r.rpt,0)) > 0.5 OR m.mine IS NULL OR r.rpt IS NULL
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter=3
),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN wk w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
wsales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT sw.store_id, sw.fiscal_year, sw.trading, count(*) AS weeks, sum(CASE WHEN ws.ns IS NULL OR ws.ns<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_weeks, round(sum(ws.ns)) AS ns
FROM store_weeks sw LEFT JOIN wsales ws USING (store_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING sum(CASE WHEN ws.ns IS NULL OR ws.ns<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sw.trading = false OR sw.store_id IN (129,136,137)
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter = 3
),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                    AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN wk w
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
  FROM store_weeks ty
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2025-10-27' - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT cs.region, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
  FROM net_lines n
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores AS stores_ty, ly.stores AS stores_ly
FROM lfl_sales ty JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region
